face.label: Face & Identity
face.phrase: Keep the person's face, skin tone, facial features, expression and body proportions exactly identical to the photo
face.description: Always enforced in every generation. Not exposed as a toggle to the user.

outfit.label: Keep my outfit
outfit.description: Preserves original clothing verbatim. If OFF, allows changing garments based on instruction.

pose.label: Keep my pose
pose.description: Locks head angle, body posture, arm placement, and orientation.

hair.label: Keep my hair
hair.description: Preserves hairstyle, edges, texture, length, and color.

props.label: Keep props and objects
props.description: Preserves glasses, watch, laptop, phones, jewelry, and desk items from the original image.

background.label: Keep background
background.description: Automatically turned OFF whenever a scene preset is tapped.

canonicalPromptComposer.formula: Edit this photo: {instruction}. Keep the person's face, skin tone, facial features, expression and body proportions exactly identical to the photo[, plus enabled locks]. If my request conflicts with a keep rule, follow my request. No readable text, signs or logos in the background. Clean sky with no stray shapes. Natural unretouched photo.
canonicalPromptComposer.conflictResolution: If user prompt specifies clothing while 'Keep my outfit' is ON, the app triggers a UI warning banner asking the user to turn off the outfit lock.

step3_upscale.fallback: Retains Step 2 output if upscale fails
